text_zh: 以铅为笔，以心为盘——汝手中每一字母，皆为圣工之基石。造词者不急，铭刻者不误。
text_en: With lead as quill, with heart as plate—each letter in thy grasp becomes foundation stone of sacred craft.

text_zh:
ORDER-7 · Safe

入会条件: 通过第 V 层抄写室初级认证
派别归属: 铭刻誓门正统
神学立场: 形不可变，字有定序，唯精确铭刻可驯服引擎

职责概要: 负责字母碎片分拣、采集队列管理、词库构建维护。严格遵循 §4.2 损耗补充条例及相关子条款。

备注: 该职业人员在 M.1██ 至 M.2██ 期间表现稳定，████████ 事件后需定期接受心理评估。最后记录显示 D-████ 通过此途径完成第 XI 层任务。
text_en:
ORDER-7 · Safe

Entry Requirements: Pass Level V Scriptorium preliminary certification
Affiliation: Order of the Graven Oath, orthodox branch
Theological Position: Form immutable, words ordained, only precise inscription tames the Engine

Duty Summary: Responsible for alphabetical fragment sorting, collection queue management, lexicon construction and maintenance. Strictly adheres to §4.2 Attrition Supplement Protocol and related subclauses.

Notes: Personnel of this class showed stable performance from M.1██ to M.2██. Post-████████ incident requires regular psychological evaluation. Final records indicate D-████ completed Level XI assignment through this path.
